pr.title: AI worktree workflows: eliminate the redundant TSDK prompt in trusted workspaces
pr.body:
### Issue
- #125978

### Description
This PR proposes updating the logic in the the TS extension's version manager to be more permissive for trusted workspaces.

#### Current Behavior
TSDKs are applied when a workspace is both trusted **and** the user has explicitly opted-in to using the workspace's TSDK via a UI prompt.

#### Proposed Behavior
If a workspace is trusted, automatically apply the workspace's TSDK. The UI prompt would only be relevant for untrusted workspaces. This change has the setting automatically be applied on startup and also when the TSDK setting changes. 

This change is useful for workspaces that have frequently-changing TSDKs, which can be the case at organizations that have custom TS distributions that see frequent updates. Requiring that a user accept a prompt every time the TSDK changes introduces friction and can unintentionally leave them running the "incorrect" version.

#### Alternatives
If applying this change broadly is not palatable, I could also envision introducing a new setting like `automaticallyApplyWorkspaceTsdk`.

commit.message:
Auto-select workspace TypeScript SDK in trusted workspaces

Eliminates the redundant prompt for workspace TSDK usage in trusted
workspaces. When a workspace is trusted and has a configured typescript.tsdk
setting, the workspace TypeScript version is automatically selected without
requiring user interaction.

The implementation modifies the useWorkspaceTsdkSetting getter to return true
for either explicit user opt-in OR trusted workspaces with a local TSDK. This
centralizes the logic and ensures all existing code automatically works with
trusted workspaces.

Fixes #125978
